question:
**Directions: Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.**

ADMIRE
solution:
The correct answer is 'Dislike.'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given word 'Admire' means **to respect or like somebody or something very much; to look at somebody or something with pleasure**. (किसी के प्रति आदर व प्रशंसा का भाव रखना; किसी को प्रिय दृष्टि से देखना)

 
 
• Example: *He is a nobleman, we all **admire** him*.
 
 
 
• ​Let's see the meaning of other given options:-
 
 
• 'Respect' means **the feeling that you have when you admire or have a high opinion of somebody or something**. (व्‍यक्ति या वस्‍तु के प्रति आदर-भावना)
 
 
• Example: *My parents brought me up to **respect** others*.
 
 
 
• 'Dislike' means **a strong feeling of not liking or approving** **someone or something**. (किसी व्‍यक्ति या वस्‍तु को नापसंद करना)
 
 
• Example: *He seems to **dislike** any form of exercise*.
 
 
 
• 'Disagree' means **to have a different opinion from somebody or something; to not agree**. (किसी से अलग राय रखना या होना; सहमत न होना)
 
 
• Example: *I strongly **disagree** with his views*.
 
 
 
• 'Approve' means **to be pleased about something; to like somebody or something**. (किसी को पसंद करना या उससे संतुष्‍ट होना; स्‍वीकार्य समझना)
 
 
• Example: *My parents don't **approve** of me smoking cigarettes*.

 
 
 
 
 

Hence, the correct answer is option 2.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The antonyms of the word 'Admire' are "dislike, disregard, **condemn**".
 
• The synonyms of the word 'Admire' are "**appreciate, approve, respect**".
